description:
Find manuals by topic, command prefix or literal option such as --recursive.

        Required field: query, including when continuing a search. All other fields are optional.
        Example: {"query":"compress files"}. Read a result with get_man_page(page_id=...).

        Returns context-preserving excerpts and page_id values for get_man_page. Aliases of
        the same document are grouped. Without product, an exact manual-name match selects
        the newest upstream version per package/name/section across active OS catalogs.
        Equal versions use deterministic distro ties; unrelated implementations stay separate.
        Topic/prefix searches use the newest numbered release per product for architecture/locale.
        Pass os_version=null to search all releases without collapsing distro variants. An explicit
        release pins OS selection. Current package builds are searched by default.
        Set historical=true to include readable older package versions within the selected OS
        releases, without automatic upstream-version selection.
        Responses name the actual OS targets searched. Repeat the query/filters with
        next_page to continue; null means finished or the configured page cap was reached.

architecture.description: Optional target CPU architecture from list_targets; defaults to x86_64. Includes compatible noarch packages. Repeat this filter for search continuation; manual page IDs/cursors already pin the architecture.
architecture.title: Architecture

historical.description: Optional; defaults to false (current package builds). True includes readable older package builds within the selected OS releases. Use os_version=null as well to search across OS releases.
historical.title: Historical

limit.description: Optional maximum grouped search results per response (1–50; default 10). Follow next_page for more results, keeping the same limit.
limit.title: Limit

locale.description: Optional manual language from list_targets; defaults to en. Repeat for search continuation; manual page IDs/cursors already pin the locale.
locale.title: Locale

os_version.description: Optional OS release. With a product, latest selects its newest release. Without product, default latest selects newest upstream versions for exact names across active catalogs. Null searches all releases without collapsing variants. An explicit release pins selection.
os_version.title: Os Version

package.description: Optional RPM package-name filter, which may differ from the command name. Applies to name lookups and searches, including search continuation.
package.title: Package

page.description: Search page (default 1). Repeat query, filters and limit. The configured maximum defaults to 5; responses include max_pages and next_page. Each request searches the current catalog; updates can shift results.
page.title: Page

product.description: Optional OS product filter. Omit or use null to search all available products.
product.title: Product

query.description: Required on every search page. A topic, command-name prefix, or literal option. Must contain 1–500 characters.
examples: how to extract files from an archive
query.title: Query

section.description: Optional manual section filter. Helps disambiguate commands, functions and file formats. Applies to name lookups and searches, including search continuation.
section.title: Section

name: search_man_pages
title: Search manual pages
